HOW LETBUYY WORKS

Build your store.
Run the business behind it.

LetBuyy brings your online shop, orders and customer tools into one workspace. Here’s how they help you, from opening day to your next collection.

01

Make it yours

Your products. Your own online store.

Give your business a home online, with your branding and a storefront that works on phones, tablets and computers.

Choose a theme and make it your own.
Add product photos, prices, sizes and stock.
Preview your shop, connect your domain and publish.
Explore storefront themes
02

Start selling

From a customer’s basket to a packed order.

Share your store link. Let customers browse and buy, then manage each order from your merchant workspace.

Offer the payment methods you have enabled.
See purchases, payment status and stock together.
Prepare shipments, add tracking and handle returns.
See how order fulfilment works
03

Keep them coming back

Turn a first purchase into a relationship.

Understand who buys from you, share your next collection and use your sales reports to decide what to do next.

Find customer profiles and purchase history.
Prepare email campaigns for subscribed customers.
Review orders and revenue to plan your next move.

What is LetBuyy?

LetBuyy is an AI-native Commerce Operating System that helps businesses manage storefronts, products, inventory, orders, payments, customers, analytics, and operations from one platform.

Unlike traditional store builders, LetBuyy is designed to run the entire commerce business, not just the online store.
